name: r0-manifest-integrity
title: R0_MANIFEST_INTEGRITY: EH subscription manifest loss prevention
description: Independent follow-up for confirmed EH manifest integrity risk. The collection path still reads legacy read_manifest(), which collapses I/O/JSON errors to an empty list, then directly overwrites manifest.json at scan completion. A damaged or interrupted manifest can therefore cause prior history to be replaced. Define and implement atomic validated replacement and non-destructive recovery, and add regression coverage. Do not change this as part of H0 GUI acceptance.
creator: cfl
